title.narrative: Jordan Guardians Project - Supporting Civil Society Organizations at local and national level to monitor public policies in key sectors in Jordan

description.narrative: The project aims at empowering CSOs in Jordan to become active agents of governance and sustainable development, through developed capacities and institutionalised coordination and participation mechanisms. The specific objective is to increase the capacity of CSOs to monitor public policies in two key sectors (education and environment) at local, governorate and national level.

title.narrative: % of targeted CSOs members reporting improved capacity to monitor local and national authorities to influence sustainable development in Jordan

description.narrative: % of targeted CSOs members reporting improved capacity to monitor local and national authorities to influence sustainable development in Jordan

comment.narrative: To assess this indicator ACTED designed a contextualized scoring system addressing all aspects of the indicator. The same set of questions will be asked in baseline and endline to appreciate progress. In the baseline study 14.7 out of 52 points was the average baseline score on the custom index representing 28 of the maximum score.
Achievement on this indicator is to be reported following the project endline survey by comparing the baseline and endline scores of the CSOs whose representatives took the both surveys.

All target CSOs have reported improved capacity to both monitor and influence local and national authorities following their participation in the project. The baseline value reflect the average score in on the GOCA tool at baseline the endline average score in 40. Please also note that there was a slight change in calculation and that the average baseline score is actually 26 not 28.
